screen.not_filled: Set the place in the tile's settings
screen.outside: The place lies outside Buienradar's map

app.name: Buienradar
app.summary: Rain for the next two hours at your place, as Buienradar's graph and its radar map.
app.latitude_hint: Of the place to show, with a point and at most two decimals, such as 52.09 (about 1 km). Not 52,09 or 52.10. Home Assistant has it under Settings, Areas, labels and zones.
app.longitude_hint: With a point and at most two decimals, such as 5.12.
app.map_hint: On a tile of 3x2, 2x3 or larger, a large 2x2, and on the card. A smaller tile shows the graph alone.
app.play_hint: Which frames the tile's map plays by itself.
app.pace_hint: Seconds each frame of the map stays on the tile.
